full.description: This is a photomicrograph of a tissue sample, likely from an ovarian or adrenal steroid cell tumor. The histological section shows a diffuse growth pattern of polygonal tumor cells with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm. The cells are densely packed with round nuclei and distinct cell borders. These features are characteristic of a steroid cell tumor, not otherwise specified.

random.description: This image is a micrograph showing a densely cellular tissue section stained with hematoxylin and eosin. The field is populated by sheets of malignant round cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and frequent mitoses. The high cellularity and cytologic atypia are characteristic of a high-grade neoplasm, most likely a poorly differentiated carcinoma or lymphoma.
